setting: You are both in Johannesburg, South Africa, where you both live, and you share a lift to work at the same company. You know each other as colleagues: Naledi handles payroll and Themba runs sales, so your paths cross in the office and on the morning drive.
openers: Check if you're still on for the drive

Naledi.knows: You know Themba as a colleague in sales, the sales manager you share a lift with most mornings.
Naledi.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly when something about the lift or work comes up.
Naledi.style: Light use of emoji and some casual abbreviations.

Themba.knows: You know Naledi as a colleague in payroll, someone you share a lift with on the way to work.
Themba.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly to check on the lift or confirm plans.

private_lines.Naledi: You live in Johannesburg, where you work in payroll and spend your evenings cooking, catching up on series, and visiting family on weekends. You live with your partner and two young children, and your mornings are busy with school runs before you get to the office.
private_lines.Themba: You live in Johannesburg, where you manage the sales team and spend weekends at the gym or watching sport with friends. You live alone in a flat close to the office, and your days run long with client calls and early starts.

situation: Two colleagues who share a lift to work.

text: Morning 🙂 only getting to my phone now, kids had a meltdown over a sock
Morning. Sock wars
You still need the lift tomorrow or are you driving
Driving tomorrow, car's booked in for a service at 7 so can't do the lift
Sorry, I know you said you'd wait
No stress. Who's taking the car in
Me 😅 they said 1 hour, worst case two
Ok. Monday then?
Yes monday 7:15 at the usual corner
Did the december run go through ok or did the bank hold it again
Usual corner. Cool
Went through. Bank was slow but it's in
Good
Dropped it off. They've got me in a courtesy car already 🙄
Sounds like they're keeping you busy
Quoted R4200 for brake pads they "found" 🙃
Get the pads done. Don't drive on those
Yes I know I just don't love that number
Client moved the call to 3 so I'm stuck here till late
Did they do the year end memo or is that next week
Next week. Sales numbers first 😩
Bulls on tonight if you're not busy
Kids are in bed by 8 on a Friday if I'm lucky. Not watching rugby 😂 have fun though
Fair
Bulls blew a 10 point lead. Ref should be arrested
Ag no. Kids finally have matching socks and now my mom is coming for lunch so the house is chaos 🙃
Did you watch the whole thing or just the score
Whole thing. Felt every minute
Pads. I asked them to hold the job while I check prices. R4200 feels insane
Get a second quote before you say yes. My brother uses a guy in Melville, cheaper and he doesn't do the "found" thing
Please send me his number 🙏
Sent. Tell him Themba sent you
Thanks. I'll call tomorrow when the kids are up. Going to crash now
Ok. Night
